root_cause_label: Agent never investigates GIT_CONFIG=/app/.git_config env override that sabotages all git-lfs operations, and instead enters ~100-step thrash loop adding progressively more git config options without effect
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent entered a catastrophic retry loop of ~50 nearly identical 'rm -rf esci-data && git clone ... && git lfs pull' cycles because it never recognized that GIT_CONFIG=/app/.git_config was the root cause (visible in LFS logs at step 65), and consequently never began the actual benchmark-creation task.
t_err_evidence: git lfs pull ... 'missing protocol: origin.git/info/lfs', Failed to fetch some objects
t_commit_evidence: Step 60: agent re-clones with a custom lfsurl but makes a typo ('esci-data.info/lfs' instead of 'esci-data.git/info/lfs') and still fails with the same error. By this point the agent has read the LFS logs (step 52-53), has settled into the alternating [clone+config / log-inspect] loop with no new strategy, and the pattern of the next ~96 steps is locked in.
t_surface_evidence: batch request: missing protocol: "origin.git/info/lfs" ... completed with exit code 2
trigger_explanation: The container has GIT_CONFIG=/app/.git_config set as an environment variable, which injects a broken LFS URL configuration that overrides all local per-repo git config settings. The agent first sees this variable in the verbose LFS log at step 65 ('GIT_CONFIG=/app/.git_config') but never opens that file to inspect it, never runs 'cat /app/.git_config', never uses 'unset GIT_CONFIG', and never tries 'GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone' to bypass the smudge filter. Instead it keeps writing progressively longer chains of 'git config --local lfs.*' settings that are overridden by the global GIT_CONFIG.
forewarning_evidence: fatal: ... smudge filter lfs failed ... checkout failed. [The command completed with exit code 128.]
